about: SQL Tools' permission lists, as Veeam's Permissions page gives them. guest_processing: full is the sysadmin role; minimal is the list headed Minimal permissions (server roles, securables, and roles in model, master and msdb). configuration_database: installation needs CREATE ANY DATABASE; operation needs db_datareader, db_datawriter and EXECUTE on the configuration database, or db_owner; upgrade recommends db_owner. A guide revision is a data edit here.

configuration_database.section: Microsoft SQL Server (where the configuration database is stored)
